headline.text: L1 Sollich 3 was down *9 hours* overnight for deep-clean after allergen cross-contact — cleared and running by 09:29.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 3 had a major allergen finding during changeover that required extended cleaning and passed final testing by mid-morning. Sollich 1 fought X-ray false rejects and multiple caramel depositor faults through second shift but stabilized after cleaning. Sollich 2 ran caramel cluster with minor capping machine complaints.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 flow wrapper upgrades by Theegarten vendor in progress, expected test by noon. FFS web tracking drifted left-over-right through second shift, causing rework; continued adjustment into first. ML3 had a brief HMI fault at startup, cleared in 15 minutes.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 battled recurring belt-shift jams between WDS and gondola and TG sensor/film issues through the night; third shift cleared most but gondola jam returned at 07:29. Truffle line stable after weight corrections. MF Matrix hopper jammed post-clean, back running by 07:13.

notes.text: Sebastian from Theegarten on-site all first shift for ML2 flow wrapper hardware and software upgrades.
Matrix technician arrived first shift to work Sollich 1 bagger tuning.

resolved.title: Sollich 1 chiller breaker tripped mid-shift
resolved.summary: Tunnel 2 chiller breaker shut off at 16:25, causing immediate temper loss and riser freeze; line paused for reheat.
resolved.resolution: Breaker reset at 16:25, reheat completed, line restarted 17:53 (Matt Hatch, Conner Boyd).

resolved.title: Sollich 3 allergen cross-contact during changeover
resolved.summary: Pretzel and pecan residue found in bagger matrices MM3 and MM5 after metal detector cleaning; required level 4 re-clean, ATP, and allergen verification before restart.
resolved.resolution: All allergen tests passed at 09:27 and line restarted at 09:29 (Mariela Gudino, Nathan Topham).

resolved.title: Sollich 1 water activity out of spec at 0.44
resolved.summary: First caramel aw reading came back at 0.44, above the 0.42 shelf-life threshold for soggy cookies; QA flagged as shelf-life concern.
resolved.resolution: Retest from new sample at 22:42 measured 0.37, within spec (Alfonsina Gil, Italu Martinez).

resolved.title: Sollich 3 metal detector missing bolts after cleaning
resolved.summary: Multiple bolts missing from metal detector frame discovered during reassembly at 02:14; team scrambled to locate hardware before startup.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 03:13 — "All missing bolts from the MD were replaced with new ones by the Maintenance team" (Luis Falcon).

resolved.title: Sollich 2 salt depositor covers removed
resolved.summary: Protective covers missing from salt depositor at 07:28; unknown why they were taken off.
resolved.resolution: Operator instructed to clean and reinstall at 07:30 (Joseph Scott).

resolved.title: ML3 mold empty control fault at startup
resolved.summary: HMI threw mold empty control fault at 06:59; maintenance had to power-cycle the depositor.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:14 — "The line is running" after power cycle (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: ML4 TG3 sensor fell out during run
resolved.summary: Vision sensor on TG3 dislodged at 21:07, halting wrapper; required bolting back into mount.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 00:02 — "Sensor was put it back in place and secured" (Jose Vasquez).

resolved.title: ML4 TG4 blowoffs at infeed near PG127
resolved.summary: Blue conveyor belts drifting and causing wrapper to reject bars at infeed station starting 23:39.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 23:55 — "blue conveyor belts were centered and tension on chain loosened a bit. Seems to be running well now" (Kimberly Morales).

resolved.title: ML4 sensor covered in chocolate causing line stop
resolved.summary: Infeed sensor on depositor area coated in chocolate at 01:25, triggering line fault.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 01:27 — "Line back up, chocolate was covering sensor on infeed" after cleaning (Kimberly Morales).

resolved.title: MF Matrix hopper jam after level 1 clean
resolved.summary: Machine failed to detect product at 06:45 post-clean; hopper overfilled and jammed, preventing caramel from reaching bucket scales.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:11 — "Back in operation it needed to be zeroed out and the hopper was overfilled/jammed" (Nathan Ruiz). Line running 07:13.

resolved.title: Truffle line piece weight out of range
resolved.summary: Weight checks flagged low at shift start; adjustments needed to bring within spec.
resolved.resolution: Weight corrected by 08:42 — "Now good weight" (TruffleLine Enrober).

needs_attention.title: Sollich 1 X-ray false rejects recurring
needs_attention.summary: X-ray rejecting pouches with false hits at top of belt; cleaning and re-learning helped temporarily but artifacts returned by mid-first shift at higher speeds.
needs_attention.status: Troy disassembled, cleaned, and re-learned product at 08:10. Ran clean 10 minutes then hits resumed by 09:09. Sensitivity tweaked at 10:11; monitoring continues.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 1 caramel depositor not syncing with line
needs_attention.summary: Depositor continued running when line stopped and wouldn't sync on restart; required hard resets twice in the shift.
needs_attention.status: First incident 13:41 resolved with hard reset. Second fault at 20:32 cleared by stopping at end of back stroke. Dakota and Curt notified; no permanent fix identified.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 capping machine jams from overfilled jars
needs_attention.summary: Chocolate above jar rim causes tip-overs and delays in capping; clearance too tight to raise cap trap, only works if chocolate stays below rim.
needs_attention.status: Identified as 90% of capping issues at 10:57. Team reminded at 11:38 to shake jars down as they fill. Ongoing operational control issue.

needs_attention.title: FFS web tracking drifting left causing white line on pouches
needs_attention.summary: Web tracking shifted left-over-right starting 15:01, printing white line on pouch front; required continuous manual adjustment and rework of bad bags.
needs_attention.status: Adjusted from 23 to 29 then back at 17:23. Line down 17:32 for rework. Continued adjustments overnight (8 to 8:07 at 20:07). Standard posted: 3mm white line max acceptable. Tracking still requiring attention as of 07:04.

needs_attention.title: ML2 flow wrapper hardware upgrades in progress
needs_attention.summary: Theegarten technician Sebastian on-site performing forming plate, rail, and program updates; line availability delayed.
needs_attention.status: Sebastian arrived 06:57, halfway through hardware at 09:57, creating recipes at 11:33. Estimated chocolate test start by noon per 09:57 update (Erandy).

needs_attention.title: ML4 belt shifting north between WDS and gondola
needs_attention.summary: Conveyor belt repeatedly drifting north causing mold jams at gondola infeed; happened at 20:46, 22:16, and 07:29.
needs_attention.status: Three separate incidents logged. Jam cleared each time but belt continues to drift. Rich reported 07:29 jam cleared by 09:59. Root cause not identified.

needs_attention.title: ML4 cooling cabinet #1 rail clearance too tight
needs_attention.summary: Paternoster rail at infeed of cooler #1 sitting only 2mm above molds (vs. 1/8 inch on other cabinets); rail on outfeed sitting directly on molds during transfer.
needs_attention.status: Torque limit on M1012 reduced from 70% to 50% as workaround at 23:24. Ray Garcia asked to reach out to WDS. No response logged as of window close.

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG4 film size adjustment issue
needs_attention.summary: Excess silver showing on wrapper exterior at 04:42; mechanics adjusting film at 04:55.
needs_attention.status: TG4 down for film size adjustment as of 04:55. No clear resolution posted by end of window.

needs_attention.title: ML4 discharge belt guide came undone
needs_attention.summary: Belt guide detached at 05:12; maintenance called.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance en route as of 05:12. No follow-up message confirming repair completion.
